_comment: Single source of truth for the bundled native extension slots. Each slot is a filename suffix that DuckDB's loader selects by ABI and the exact DuckDB release tag that binary must be built for. ALL slots build from HEAD sources: extensions/common/duckdb_compat.hpp adapts to the 1.5.x and 2.0 vector/bind APIs, so there is no per-ABI source pin any more. scripts/build_extension_bundles.py builds these; fhir4ds/tests/test_extension_abi_stamp.py verifies the stamped bundles. DuckDB compares the extension's embedded source-id against the client version string EXACTLY, so a bundle stamped with a bare commit hash instead of the tag is rejected by every released client.
